```
https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.KeyVault
```

**Notes:**
- The direct URL `https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.KeyVault` can be used to jump straight to the creation form.
- In the Security category, there are two related services: **"Azure Key Vault Managed HSM"** (a dedicated HSM service) and the standard **"Key Vault"** (the one for secrets/keys/certificates). The standard "Key Vault" is the one to use for typical key vault creation.
